title: A Survey on Safe Multi-Modal Learning Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewed as being evaluated and mitigated through pre-processing techniques like gender-norming, iterative gendered predictor removal, and in-processing techniques such as adversarial learning.
Reviewed as being evaluated and mitigated through a combination of adversarial learning and data balancing strategies.
Reviewed in the context of multilingual fairness benchmarks, which evaluate bias by measuring equalized predictive performance and semantic consistency across different languages.
